vote_meta.question: vi
vote_meta.seat_note: Ranges from 20,000 simulations: 95% of results fall within each range. The Coalition is the Liberals and Nationals together. A majority is 76 of the 150 seats.
vote_meta.trend_note: The 2025 figures are the May 2025 federal election result. The other points are the DemosAU / Capital Brief national polls in 2026; the Coalition was led by Sussan Ley in the two January polls and by Angus Taylor from February. Polls are evenly spaced along the line, not by date.

seat_notes: 1. Result of 20,000 Monte Carlo simulations. Low = 2.5 percentile, High = 97.5 percentile
